title: Concurrency and threading — concept map
intro: This module covers shared state and parallelism: the thread pool, Task Parallel Library (TPL), locks, Interlocked, races, deadlocks, concurrent collections, Channels, and a real cache-stampede scenario. Async input/output composition stays in module 13 — the hard rule here is never hold a lock across Redis, Simple Queue Service (SQS), or HTTP.

conceptCards.title: lock and Interlocked
conceptCards.summary: lock for multi-step invariants. Interlocked for counters. volatile for flag visibility only. SemaphoreSlim for throttling.

conceptCards.title: Thread pool and TPL
conceptCards.summary: Task.Run and Parallel for CPU. ReaderWriterLockSlim for read-heavy snapshots. async for I/O.

conceptCards.title: Races and deadlocks
conceptCards.summary: Races from unsynchronized shared state. Deadlocks from circular lock waits. Fixed lock ordering.
conceptCards.example: Dictionary in parallel RabbitMQ handlers — use ConcurrentDictionary

conceptCards.title: Concurrent collections
conceptCards.summary: ConcurrentDictionary, Channel for producer-consumer. Bounded channel for backpressure.
conceptCards.example: await foreach var msg in channel.Reader.ReadAllAsync()

conceptCards.title: Cache stampede
conceptCards.summary: 199 to 999 users, cold Redis key. Single-flight per key. Semaphore on DB. No lock across I/O.
